messages: It seems that #p506#, having regained her memories of the past, is eager to share the news with her father.

Amazingly, #p506# recovered from her amnesia with the help of her toy sword. It was amazing! The only thing left now is for #p506# and #p206# to finally reunite. But first, I have to get this letter from #p506# back to #p206#.
I was so glad that #p506# got her memory back. I was even gladder that #p206# finally got to see his daughter again! How touching...
name: I Need to Find My Daughter 2
